title: Construct a connected 18-stage root and bound its native completion (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Construct the connected L=18, rho=1 extension left open in #6937: 38 independent roles, 39 rank-one units, commuting stage masks and a **2,370-event dyadic caller**. Its exact action is Q times the diagonal product of the 18 independent body variables. L3 and L9 instances supply source-bound controls.

**No new κ.** The caller invokes 18 specified HOST(t=-1) macros whose native implementation remains unbuilt. It explicitly retains 181 idle jobs, three queries and 2,168 ordinary events. The per-stage native price must be below 17.13134090285433 at the pending benchmark.

The package also proves why two proposed shortcuts fail. Same-frame main-plane remix cannot extract an autonomous resonant HOST. For the pinned F+H1 repair, an exact eligibility-compression argument bounds even free coordinate-role idle merging: saving 9.707289925177 versus required 10.081828034876 per port. A complete-profile interval proof keeps this repair's moment negative throughout **κ in [0.00362701882, 0.01]**.

## Sources and verification

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Extends #6937's mask pattern, not its literal vectors; credits #6842's normalization and #6936's root/grammar. The F profile is #6824 through #6833; all exported heads, paths and byte pins are in INPUT-PINS.json.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/connected-l18-root-caller
```

All seven registered checks pass read-only: deterministic construction, exact four-character replay, complete census, independently implemented root/sector checks, reverse formal Q4 replay of all **1,444 coefficients**, exact coalescing optimum and uniform interval bound. Repeated body-variable powers are preserved. Controls reject omitted/wrong operations, malformed host/incidence assignments, omitted paid adapters and reversed intervals. Assertion-based entry points reject optimized mode; the explicit-exception coalescing check also passes optimized replay.

## Limits and credit

The negative results concern this fixed native profile and coordinate-role merging. Noncoordinate idle directions, changed roots, helper mixing and genuinely new native words remain open. Native realization, ordinary/physical tariffs, compiler and all five framework assumptions remain unresolved; no selected-frontier change or unconditional theorem.

Prepared for **@CubeJerry (Jerry Chen)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate implementations for independent checks. Credit DreamingOfClouds, #6912's caller precedent and all retained native/root authors. The complete-sign header is prior; the connected mask geometry, emitted caller and scoped completion analysis are new.
